name: 03-projector-pitch
prompt: A warm private dining room where a projector screen has suddenly lit up with a generic sales slide, slide content completely blurred and unreadable, a cold white glow cutting across the room, three diners in suits looking quietly unimpressed. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
